container.platform: Linux x86-64, Python 3.12.3, Podman/Rosetta on Apple M3 Pro
container.pybdsf_scope: Released integration dependency only, not the pinned-master performance gate

defaults.decision: Maintainer's choice of 17 October 2026 from the truth-based gate (Hebog plan task 81): continuum passes it under either background since its local noise no longer degenerates in crowded fields, and compact fails it; zero keeps PyBDSF's mean map and covers more of the true emission. Replaces the interim compact choice of 13 October

implementation.distributed_path: Hebog's tasks run on single-threaded worker processes the filter task starts for a step of several cores (maintainer's decisions of 12 and 14 November 2026); running them on Rapthor's own client needs Rapthor's later layout change
implementation.hebog_version: A wheel built from Hebog commit 05808eeb (branch feat/rapthor-sector-memory), labelled 0.25.0 until it is released; 0.26 will be the first release with hebog.adapters.sector_memory
implementation.layout: One single-threaded Dask worker per node, started non-daemonic; for more than one core the Prefect task starts a LocalCluster of that many single-threaded worker processes, memory actions off, with memory and cores resources, and passes a DaskExecutor; one core, the sync runner and daemonic workers use a ThreadExecutor
implementation.memory_reservation: hebog.adapters.sector_memory divides the worker's budget, less the task's resident RSS, between the analysis (hebog.analysis_memory_bytes for the sources hebog.expected_source_count estimates from the detection image at threshpix), 256 MiB for each worker process and the tile tasks, shared equally between the worker processes; an ExecutorAdmissionError, when no memory remains for the tile tasks or one needs more than a worker's share, falls back to PyBDSF
implementation.publication: Commit c91e1575 on local branch feat/hebog-worker-processes over 632f6211, over add-hebog-source-finder of https://git.astron.nl/RD/rapthor; not pushed, not merged

memory_estimate.bound: Bounded the most sources any profile/background lane published on all 21 quick-check, Rapthor-agreement and task-23 cases, at 1.0 to 21 times; 1.1 to 1.9 on the LOFAR and simulated SKA fields; 21 on wide-extended-source
memory_estimate.scope: Development machine, native macOS; the agreement lanes from run task23-pin-st and the benchmark count from run task23-first; no separate evidence record

profile_smoke.limitation: Three isolated sources, identical true/apparent input; catalogue-cut checks only, not component-retention agreement or task-21 safety strata

quick_science_check.result: no regressions; all 54 catalogue, RMS and mask FITS products byte-identical

reproduce.native_integration: See scripts/validation/containers/rapthor/README.md; tests are archived in the pinned Rapthor commit

scope: Current-layout integration with task-owned worker processes, the continuum/zero defaults, sector_memory's division of memory and the PyBDSF fallback, at the Rapthor and LSMTool pins of 17 October 2026; no scientific or performance qualification

upstream_audit.result: Pin move of 17 October 2026. Rapthor main gained one commit (aff26023, an array-beam option) that changes nothing in the filter step. LSMTool master gained twelve commits that refactor skymodel.py and tableio.py (private helpers renamed, _get_xy faster) and leave filter_skymodel/, the mask lookup and the test resources unchanged; its declared dependencies are the same. The change rebases onto aff26023 without conflict.
